Corrected only review #485 findings S1–S3; this remains an author-checked synthetic design awaiting independent review.
Starting commit/tree: `8fc86feca449c9a844394343b256f5f197f9e248` / `333a5d3821c2dbe7da194279c87c492907877e3b`.
Before editing, all six writing hashes matched reviewed candidate `7435c05c4fd7ddbaafb6f5db9081ad5a4f5db427` / tree `555960a979f4bec474850a39bd9b284b7188496a`; ten other paths differed in session reports, iterations and working memory, recorded in [correction evidence](../benchmark/writing/review-corrections.json).
That evidence pins the source URLs, snapshots and exported hashes of #481 and independent REVISE review #485, plus starting/reviewed six-file hashes and exact counterexample mutations/outcomes.
S1: corrected only the baseline identity fields to git-verified `486030b461e57ca0f322a17a5b7853e83e9655e3` / `cf75cf6892de2f9410fa09ee2589dcba47d825a4`; the previous named commit is unresolvable locally, with no provenance invented.
All 62 protected hashes match baseline, reviewed and current bytes; all 56 unique preparation-index pins (74 references) remain intact; protocol, index and status are unchanged.
S2: both modification paths now require output version equality with the preserved original and frozen expectation; creation retains its requested-version rule.
Before correction, original and original_after=`SYNTHETIC-v0`, output/frozen=`SYNTHETIC-v1` falsely passed ordinary and source-rebuild checks; both now reject with `version-drift`.
S3: independently require `request`, `originals`, `allowed_inputs`, `model`, `budgets`, `key_revision`, `repetitions`, derived from protocol:79–84, the runner contract and writing comparison; preserve matching-value/key-set and arm invariants.
Deleting each setting from frozen and both arms falsely passed before correction; all seven now reject with `pair-setting-required`, including the review's missing-key counterexample.
All 35 original rejecting controls remain byte-for-byte equivalent; nine additions bring the total to 44, with five positive checks passing; [controls](../benchmark/writing/controls.json) and [verification](../benchmark/writing/verification.json) retain durable evidence.
`python3 -I benchmark/writing/verify_method.py` passed; an audited repeat from `/` with environment={} and session reads/file mutation denied produced identical stdout; preparation `--check` passed with no errors and benchmark_ready=false.
Actual changed paths, relative to benchmark/writing/: `README.md`, `controls.json`, `input-pins.json`, `review-corrections.json` (new), `verification.json`, `verify_method.py`; `method.json` is unchanged; whitespace and refreshed-hash checks passed.
Final parent checkpoint: commit `f86939aed871aee754a096d9b378870ebb39d095`, tree `50a0180535642f6fda877a5acea9e4c3801acd51`; no git commit command was issued by this role.

## What next

Request a separate reviewer session for these changed bytes and the pinned candidate, using the correction evidence and verification record; the parent supplies the final published commit/tree if it rewrites checkpoints.
Resume from benchmark/writing/ and its adjacent-only verification command; avoid repeating POC reverse engineering, corpus searches or global gap maps, and never replace the historical baseline with a session checkpoint.
Native capability/grants (#169), original versions/consumer maps, matching build sources/tools, independent native references/checkers, restricted allocation/tested isolation, quota/precision decisions and all-version writing estimates remain prerequisites. Owner consideration of method acceptance follows independent review; acceptance was not sought here.
